textbookText: 2. Name the instrument which is made on the basis of expansion of heat.
Ans:- A thermometer is an instrument made on the basis of expansion of heat.
3. On what factors do the quantity of heat of an object depend?
Ans:- The quantity of heat of an object depends on its mass, specific heat capacity, and change in temperature.
4. Define heat according to molecular theory.
Ans:- Heat is the energy transferred due to the difference in average kinetic energy of molecules.
5. What is heat equation?
Ans:- The heat equation is Q = m × c × ΔT.
6. On the basis of which principle, thermometer is constructed?
Ans:- A thermometer is constructed on the principle of thermal expansion of liquids.
7. In which two factors does the heat gain or loss by any object depend upon?
Ans:- Heat gain or loss by an object depends on its mass and specific heat capacity.
8. Name two thermometric liquids.
Ans:- Two thermometric liquids are mercury and alcohol.
9. What is meant by thermal energy?
Ans:- Thermal energy is the total kinetic energy of all molecules in a substance.
10. What is specific heat capacity? Write its SI unit.
Ans:- Specific heat capacity is the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of 1 kg of a substance by 1°C, and its SI
unit is J/kg°C.
11. Describe the condition in which water can be boiled at a temperature less than 100 °C.
Ans:- Water can be boiled at a temperature below 100°C when the external air pressure is reduced.
Section C
Short answer type questions
1. If equal amount of heat energy is given to the two objects with equal mass, there will be differences in temperature, why?
Ans:- If equal amounts of heat energy are given to two objects of equal mass, their temperature changes will differ because
each object has a different specific heat capacity. A substance with lower specific heat capacity heats up faster, while one
with higher specific heat capacity shows a smaller rise in temperature.
2. During high fever, a wet clean cloth is kept on the forehead of the patient, why?
Ans:- A wet cloth is kept on the patient’s forehead during high fever because the water in the cloth absorbs heat from the
body and evaporates, helping to cool the patient. This process lowers the body temperature by removing excess heat.

4. White down the causes that the night in desert is very cold and day of that place is very hot.
Ans:- The desert becomes very hot during the day because sand heats up quickly due to its low specific heat capacity. At
night, it becomes very cold because the sand also loses heat rapidly, causing the temperature to drop sharply.
5. Why do specific heat capacity of objects differ?
Ans:- The specific heat capacity of objects differs because different materials have different molecular structures and
bonding. These differences cause some substances to require more heat to raise their temperature, while others need less.
6. The water kept in Earthen pot remains cold in summer season, why?
Ans:- Water kept in an earthen pot remains cold in summer because the porous walls allow water to seep out and evaporate,
and this evaporation removes heat from the water inside, keeping it cool.
